question: Does the human PI grant final acceptance to the recorded Colored Petri Net workflow architecture after the bounded periodic KS/GKS electronic-structure, PAW, hybrid-deferral, and deferred ABINIT-conformance correction, with P0 and every implementation/execution task remaining unlaunched?

options.summary: Accept the corrected architecture and close this architecture pass.
options.consequence: The CPN and periodic KS/GKS integration architecture becomes the accepted prospective control-plane authority. P0 remains unlaunched and still requires a separate explicit human launch decision; no dependency, implementation, pseudopotential, hybrid, ABINIT, QE/Wannier execution, or external calculation is authorized.

options.summary: Request specified additional architecture corrections before acceptance.
options.consequence: The architecture task remains open and blocked at final acceptance; only the specified control-plane corrections and their revalidation are authorized.

options.summary: Defer final acceptance without rejecting the recorded architecture.
options.consequence: The architecture remains provisional, P0 stays unlaunched, and no implementation or external execution may proceed.

recommendation: Option A: accept the corrected architecture. Affected validation passes, and all four focused read-only lanes pass after deterministic corrections CPN-010 and CPN-011. Acceptance must not be interpreted as authorization to launch P0, implement a backend, add a dependency, select a pseudopotential, or execute an external tool.
blocked_scope: Architecture closeout, P0 eligibility for a later separately authorized launch, and every downstream implementation or execution task.
safe_scope: Read-only inspection and reporting of the accepted architecture. P0 and every implementation or execution task remain unlaunched pending separate explicit human authorization.
normalized_decision: Option A accepted: the corrected CPN and periodic KS/GKS electronic-structure architecture is human-accepted and the architecture task is closed. P0 remains unlaunched; no dependency, implementation, pseudopotential, or external-execution authority is granted.
authorized_scope: Close CPN-HC01 and the backend-neutral-cpn-workflow-architecture task as human-accepted; record the accepted architecture scope only. Do not launch P0 or authorize dependencies, implementation, pseudopotential selection, or QE, ABINIT, or Wannier90 execution.
